title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1010 | 火星日出、194岁乌龟、深海新物种
ending_game: Lina 的无厘头二选一：和 Jonathan 乌龟一起吃早餐，还是和小企鹅一起游泳？你选哪个？

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hey everyone, welcome to our very first episode! I'm Mia.

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: And I'm Lina! It's Saturday, October tenth! I'm so excited!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Me too! We've got three amazing stories for you today!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Story one! A photo from Mars!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: That's right! NASA's Curiosity rover took a picture of dawn on Mars!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Dawn? Like sunrise? On Mars?!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Exactly! The sun came up over cliffs and rocks. Oh, it's so beautiful! The rover has been exploring Mars since twenty twelve!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Twenty twelve?! That's older than me!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha! It is! It's a car-sized robot with six wheels, climbing a mountain on Mars!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I want a six-wheeled car! Can it do my homework?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Oh, I wish! But probably not. Hey, here's our word of the day: species. A species is a type of animal. Dogs are one species, cats are another!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: So I'm the Lina species?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: The one and only! Say it with us, friends! Species!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Species!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: I love how you said that! Okay, story two! Get ready... Meet Jonathan! He's a tortoise, and he's one hundred and ninety-four years old!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: One hundred and ninety-four?! Is he a dinosaur?!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha! Great question! Not quite a dinosaur, but wow... he was born before phones and cars were even invented! Can you believe it?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Whoa! What's his secret? Does he eat pizza?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Oh, I love that idea! But no pizza, sweetie. Scientists say it's in his genes! He just keeps going! He's the oldest land animal in the whole world!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: When I'm one hundred and ninety-four, I'm going to nap like Jonathan!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! That's the perfect plan! Okay, last story! Scientists found fifty-seven new species in the deep sea!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Fifty-seven?! Did they find a mermaid?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: No mermaids! But they found a sea cucumber that looks like SpongeBob's friend! Isn't that amazing?

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: SpongeBob is real! I told you! Did they find Patrick too?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Not yet! They used a robot submarine in super deep, dark water!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: It's dark down there? Do the fish bring flashlights?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha ha ha! I love how you think! Okay, it's game time!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Ooh, my favorite! Would you rather... have breakfast with Jonathan the tortoise, or swim with the little penguins?

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Hmm, tough one... I'd pick breakfast with Jonathan! Imagine the stories he could tell! What about you, friends? Ask your mom and dad too!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: I'd swim with the penguins! They could teach me to swim super fast!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Ha! I love it! Great choice!

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Thanks for hanging out with us on our very first episode! See you next time! Bye!

turns.speaker: Lina
turns.text: Bye! I'm going to nap like Jonathan!
